sources.title: Multi-Modal Generative AI: Multi-modal LLM, Diffusion and Beyond
sources.snippet: Abstract Multi-modal generative AI has received increasing attention in both academia and industry. sources.title: Runway Gen-3 Alpha: AI Video Generation with Temporal Control
sources.snippet: Runway Gen-3 Alpha is the first of the next generation of AI foundation models trained by Runway on a new infrastructure built for large-scale multimodal training. It is a major improvement in AI model fidelity, consistency and motion over Gen-2, and a step towards building General World Models.
